title: Idle unload never resets a newly started recording
steps: Complete or cancel recording
Start another recording as the idle unload expires
Observe red recording state
Stop and observe transcription
expected: The active recording or transcription retains its state when the previous unload completes.

title: Opening the practice guide brings it above a maximized browser
steps: Focus maximized Firefox
Use tray > How to use / Practice
Confirm guide is visible in front
Close guide using Close guide
Repeat
expected: Both openings make the guide visible immediately without requiring its taskbar button.

title: Recording input feedback distinguishes silence and voice
steps: Start recording with silent input
Wait two seconds and inspect the dim mic and check-mute status
Feed voice and observe changing glow and bars
Stop or cancel
expected: Input feedback reacts while recording, clears the silence hint when sound returns, and ends when capture stops.

title: Forward recovers a selected recent transcript
steps: Complete six distinct recordings
Open Recent transcripts and confirm five newest rows
Select an older row and close history
Focus native, browser or terminal field
Press Forward
expected: Selected text is inserted once without Enter or browser Forward navigation; selection itself does not paste; oldest sixth result has been evicted.

title: Five-item history stays within the desktop work area
steps: Complete six short transcripts
Open Recent transcripts at the standard Mint desktop viewport
Inspect all five rows and preview
Close using Close history
Reopen
expected: Chooser and Close history remain visible above the bottom panel; preview scrolls instead of growing the window beyond the screen.

title: Windowed installer downloads a public model without console streams
steps: Install the frozen Windows package
Open Model setup and choose tiny
Download selected model; close and reopen setup during download
Wait for Model ready; record and transcribe offline
expected: Download completes without a NoneType.write or incomplete-repository-cache error; controls recover, and setup saves a model that can immediately transcribe offline.

title: Setup and practice controls fit larger Windows display scaling
steps: Run Windows at 100%, 125% and 150% display scaling
Open Model setup, Practice and Recent transcripts
Use and close each window; scroll instructional or preview text
expected: Start/Stop, folder selection, download and Close controls remain visible above the taskbar.

title: A failed action does not disable Back, recovery or Quit
steps: Fail a configuration action
Continue recording or finish transcription
Recover selected text and Quit
expected: The dispatcher keeps running; unrelated configuration errors do not cancel active work; failed completion unlocks controls.

title: Interrupted settings writes preserve the previous configuration
steps: Save a valid configuration
Simulate a write failure during a subsequent save
Reload configuration
expected: The previous complete configuration survives and temporary partial output is removed.

title: Quit and capture failure release their owned resources
steps: Start recording while the model starts
On Windows, force-close the GUI with a live model worker
Quit, or disconnect the fixture microphone
Verify process/input cleanup; relaunch and record again
expected: No orphan worker, stuck hook, abandoned capture or permanently loaded idle model remains.

title: Uninstall removes owned startup and launchers while retaining user models/configuration
steps: Install with login startup enabled
Quit and uninstall
Verify startup/program entries removed, model/config retained
Reinstall and sign in again
expected: A single listener starts at login with no model worker before first capture; unrelated installations and retained user data are untouched.

title: Local punctuation preserves words and internal sentence boundaries
steps: Dictate a statement followed by a question
Wait for processing
Inspect native/browser text and history
expected: Punctuation is present, wording is preserved, and the same completed result appears in every recovery surface.

title: Missing model keeps unprocessed dictation recoverable without automatic paste
steps: Start with speech ready and punctuation missing
Record and stop
Observe saved error and unchanged target
Download through Punctuation setup
Tray Retry while setup is focused
Focus destination and Forward
expected: No raw automatic paste or history loss; Retry does not transcribe audio again or paste into setup, and Forward recovers the completed result.

title: Question predictions correct default recognition periods safely
steps: Dictate Can you open the report
Inspect final question mark
Check a declarative What is important is safety. and Please note: corpus cases
expected: Model-predicted questions gain question marks; fallback does not reinterpret an existing statement or header.

title: Literal data and protected spans stay intact
steps: Run the fixed corpus with decimals, IDs, code/calls, inline multiword code and links
Copy/Forward completed prose
expected: No word joins, numeric changes or code corruption; sentence marks may follow protected spans, never appear inside them.

title: Prose insertion and Copy add one trailing separator
steps: Complete two dictations in one field without adding spaces
Copy a selected result
Replace clipboard externally
Forward again
expected: Consecutive results are separated, history stays trimmed, recovered text ignores external clipboard, and no Enter/newline is generated. Recognized literals get no added separator.

title: Clean Windows setup validates the model CDN certificate
steps: Install on a clean Windows client
Open Punctuation setup and Download
Wait for ready
Dictate offline
expected: Bundled public roots extend the system trust store; hostname/certificate validation remains enabled and verified files work in the frozen app.

title: Interrupted setup safely retires partial model files
steps: Quit while model setup is downloading
Relaunch and explicitly download again
Try a simultaneous second setup
expected: OS lock protects an active downloader; after interruption the next lock owner removes its stale partial file, and only hash-verified complete files become usable.

title: Double stop requests one guarded Enter without a second recording
steps: Use qa/submission.html with public synthetic speech through a disposable virtual microphone
Stop once: wait for punctuated text and Enter count 0; Forward recovery also leaves count unchanged
Record again, click Stop twice within 0.75 seconds including a fast <0.3-second double-click
Verify one submitted completed transcript and no second recording
Repeat late second click, silence, changed focus, held modifier, punctuation failure/retry and Quit before completion
expected: Only an explicit in-window double-stop sends one Enter after validated paste. Silence/errors/auto-stop/retry/Quit cannot carry submission into later output; history/Forward retain completed text.
